info.title: PaddleOCR for .NET — command-line tool
info.description: `paddleocr-sharp`, the command-line front-end to the PaddleOCR .NET library: parse pages of a PDF or an image to markdown and JSON, recognise a single cropped block, fetch the models, and benchmark the stages. Pure C#, no ONNX Runtime and no Paddle Inference.

x-inspectra.truncationReason: Help crawling exceeded the per-command timeout budget of 3 timed-out help invocations at 'bench'.

commands.name: bench
commands.description: Measure throughput of the model stages

options.name: --width
options.description: Synthetic page size (default: 1024x1024)

options.name: --iterations
options.description: Repeats per stage (default: 3)

options.name: --tokens
options.description: Tokens to decode per iteration (default: 32)

options.name: --no-vl
options.description: Skip the vision tower and decoder

options.name: --no-layout
options.description: Skip the layout graph

options.name: --gemm
options.description: Sweep the GEMM shapes the model issues

options.name: --calibrate
options.description: Skip the machine measurement that heads the run

options.name: --calibrate-seconds
options.description:
Time to spend measuring the machine (default: 4)
Every run begins by measuring this machine — FMA rate at each vector width, cache and
memory bandwidth, and the spread across samples — because stage times from a shared
host are not comparable between runs without it. PADDLEOCR_SHARP_VECTOR_BITS=256|512
overrides the vector width the kernels choose.

commands.name: download
commands.description: Fetch models into the local cache

options.name: --model-dir
options.description: Use a checkpoint directory instead of the cache

options.name: --cache
options.description: Override the cache root (default: ~/.cache/paddleocr-sharp)

options.name: --endpoint
options.description: Hugging Face-compatible endpoint (default: HF_ENDPOINT)

options.name: --layout-dir
options.description: Use a PP-DocLayoutV3 directory instead of the cache

options.name: --no-layout
options.description: Send the whole page to the VL model

options.name: --layout-threshold
options.description: Detection score threshold (default: 0.3)

options.name: --chart
options.description: Recognise charts instead of keeping them as images

options.name: --seal
options.description: Recognise seals instead of keeping them as images

options.name: --ocr-images
options.description: Run OCR over image blocks too

options.name: --doc-orientation
options.description: Rotate pages upright before parsing

options.name: --doc-unwarping
options.description: Flatten curled pages before parsing

options.name: --prompt-label
options.description:
Whole-page mode label when --no-layout (e.g. spotting)
ocr | table | formula | chart | seal | spotting  (default: ocr)

options.name: --dpi
options.description: PDF rendering resolution (default: 200)

options.name: --max-pages
options.description: Stop after this many PDF pages

options.name: --password
options.description: Password for an encrypted PDF

options.name: --output-dir
options.description: Write <name>.md, <name>.json and imgs/ per page

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format when writing to stdout

options.name: --max-new-tokens
options.description:
Token budget per block (default: 8192)
Token budget (default: 8192)

options.name: --stop-on-repetition
options.description:
Stop a block once its output has fallen into a verbatim
cycle (default: true). The tokens this skips are the ones
the repetition truncator discards anyway.

options.name: --profile
options.description: Print tokens, timings and allocations for the call

options.name: --prompt
options.description: Raw instruction, overrides --prompt-label

options.name: --temperature
options.description: 0 selects greedy decoding (default: 0)

options.name: --top-p
options.description: Nucleus mass; ignored when greedy

options.name: --min-pixels
options.description: Lower pixel budget (default: 112896)

options.name: --max-pixels
options.description:
Upper pixel budget (default: 1003520)
--<kind>-max-pixels <n> Per-label ceiling, overriding --max-pixels; <kind> is one
of ocr, table, chart, formula, seal

options.name: --format-block-content
options.description: Put each block's rendered form in the JSON, not its raw text

options.name: --merge-tables
options.description: Rejoin tables split across a page break

options.name: --title-levels
options.description: Set heading depth from the whole document
